description: Forward one received email to one of the line's own inboxes: its forwarding, notification or Bot inbox, or the owner's sign-in address (defaults to the forwarding inbox). It cannot forward to any other address, and a new inbox must be confirmed by its owner first.

email_id.description: Id of the received email to forward.

to.description: One of the line's own inboxes. Omit to use the forwarding inbox, or the notification inbox when no forwarding inbox is set.

name: forward_email
title: Forward an email
